question: Mahita is painting the four walls of her study room, which is shaped like a cube with a side length of 18.5 feet. What is the total area she needs to paint (in square feet)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **four walls** of a **cube** = 4 × side²

Side = 18.5 feet

Area = 4 × (18.5)² = 4 × 342.25

Area = 1369 sq. ft.

**∴ The correct answer is 1369 sq. ft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Shape of the room = **Cube**

Side length (a) = 18.5 feet

**Formula Used:**

**Lateral Surface Area** of a cube = 4a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea1161ec09c1dc52edf51213d29c334b2144f3eff8b0b3b5b8fe1c54648230c3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total area to paint = Area of 4 vertical walls

⇒ Area = 4 × (18.5) × (18.5)

⇒ Area = 4 × 342.25

⇒ Area = 1369 sq. ft.

**∴ The correct answer is 1369 sq. ft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

It includes all 6 faces (top, bottom, and 4 walls). Formula: 6a².

Volume of Cube

The capacity or space occupied by the cube. Formula: a³.

Diagonal of Cube

The longest distance between two opposite corners. Formula: a√3.</p
